in_marathi.name: Suvam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pure, Good, Clear
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suvam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is pure, virtuous, and good. A person who embodies the qualities of truth, knowledge, and morality. Suvam is a name that signifies the highest ideals of Hindu spirituality.
